checks.known_gap: OBSERVED GAP, not tuned away. The manifest expects segment-aware validation, but the frozen NBE excludes an action at or above its ceiling (NBE spec R9): Community D6 is 0.60, equal to the 0.6 ceiling of segment_level_analysis, so the action would reduce nothing and is not listed, although the heterogeneity flag fires. The AC-5 clause "NBE recommends segment-aware validation" is therefore NOT MET by the frozen NBE v0.2 (Day-7 report, acceptance matrix AC-5).
